scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
Greetings young warrior, I'm the Exorcist Master Fahae.
I have been tracking the elusive Bacsojin for some time.
scripts.translation:
[驅魔大師 法海]
年輕的戰士，你好，我是驅魔大師法海。
我追蹤行蹤詭秘的白素貞，已經有一陣子了。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
I feel it is time I let another warrior try to complete
my quest. I have some items to assist you in my quest.
scripts.translation:
[驅魔大師 法海]
是時候讓另一位戰士接手這項任務了。
我這裡有些物品，能幫你完成任務。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
I have 2 items which might become useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[驅魔大師 法海]
我有兩件物品，或許對你有用。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
How many do you require?
You may only buy 5 at one time.
Each costs 20000z.
(Type in 0 to cancel)
scripts.translation:
[驅魔大師 法海]
需要多少？
一次最多購買5個，每個20,000 Zeny。
（輸入0取消）

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
Here you go, I hope you may succeed in my quest.
scripts.translation:
[驅魔大師 法海]
給你，希望你能成功完成我的任務。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
You must not be stingy, it is the path of God to be honest.
scripts.translation:
[驅魔大師 法海]
不可吝嗇，行正道須以誠為本。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
The path of fully vanquishing evil is far, help me in the way of God.
scripts.translation:
[驅魔大師 法海]
除盡邪惡，仍任重道遠。
請助我一臂之力，弘揚正道。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
How many do you require?
You may only buy 5 at one time.
Each costs 10000z.
(Type in 0 to cancel)
scripts.translation:
[驅魔大師 法海]
需要多少？
一次最多購買5個，每個10,000 Zeny。
（輸入0取消）

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
Here you go, I hope you may succeed in my quest.
scripts.translation:
[驅魔大師 法海]
給你，希望你能成功完成我的任務。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
Money doesn't bring joy to everyone, but we need it to support the temple and myself. Please, try to kill some monsters and take their drops.
scripts.translation:
[驅魔大師 法海]
錢財未必能讓人人快樂，但維持寺廟和我的生計，總少不了它。
去打些魔物，收集它們掉落的東西吧。
